--pr-black.meaning: The project's black: text in light, the page in dark. Need not be #000.

--pr-white.meaning: The project's white: the page in light, text in dark. Need not be #fff.

--pr-primary.meaning: The project's one theme colour. Roles derive from it, adjusted for contrast.

--pr-companion-angle.meaning: How far round the wheel the companion sits from the primary (Complementary by default).

--pr-tertiary-angle.meaning: How far round the wheel the tertiary sits from the primary (Complementary by default).

--pr-companion-lightness.meaning: How much lighter (positive) or darker (negative) the companion is than the primary.

--pr-tertiary-lightness.meaning: How much lighter (positive) or darker (negative) the tertiary is than the primary.

--pr-color-surface.meaning: The page itself. The white in light, the black in dark.

--pr-color-text.meaning: Text and icons that carry content. The black in light, the white in dark.

--pr-color-text-muted.meaning: Text that supports other text: descriptions, captions, metadata.

--pr-color-surface-raised.meaning: Something on top of the page: a menu, a popover, a dialog.

--pr-color-surface-sunken.meaning: A well in the page holding content of another kind: code, a table header.

--pr-color-border.meaning: A line that separates: a divider, a table rule. Decoration, so faint.

--pr-color-border-control.meaning: The edge of something you operate: a field, a checkbox. Meets 3:1.

--pr-color-primary.value: light-dark(oklch(from var(--pr-primary) min(l, 0.5) c h), oklch(from var(--pr-primary) max(l, 0.76) min(c, 0.15) h))
--pr-color-primary.meaning: Where something happens: the primary action, links, the current place, focus. The primary, darkened or lightened until it reads.

--pr-color-on-primary.meaning: Text and icons on a primary fill: black or white, whichever reads.

--pr-color-companion.value: oklch(from var(--pr-color-primary) calc(l + var(--pr-companion-lightness)) c calc(h + var(--pr-companion-angle)))
--pr-color-companion.meaning: Goes with the primary: a second emphasis, a highlight, a second series. Never an action.

--pr-color-tertiary.value: oklch(from var(--pr-color-primary) calc(l + var(--pr-tertiary-lightness)) c calc(h + var(--pr-tertiary-angle)))
--pr-color-tertiary.meaning: A third hue for decoration and a third series. Never an action.

--pr-color-backdrop.meaning: Covers the page behind something that interrupts.

--pr-color-danger.meaning: Something failed, or cannot be undone.

--pr-color-danger-surface.meaning: The quiet background behind a danger message.

--pr-color-warning.meaning: Needs attention soon; nothing has failed.

--pr-color-warning-surface.meaning: The quiet background behind a warning message.

--pr-color-info-surface.meaning: The quiet background behind an info message.

--pr-color-success-surface.meaning: The quiet background behind a success message.

--pr-font-sans.value: "Google Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Hebrew", Arial, sans-serif
--pr-font-sans.meaning: All interface and reading text, in English and Hebrew: Google Sans, bundled with Primal, falling back to the system font.

--pr-font-mono.value: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

--pr-text-display.meaning: A display title, at most one per page.

--pr-leading-tight.meaning: Line height for headings and single-line controls.

--pr-weight-strong.meaning: Headings and emphasis. One step, so weight keeps meaning rank.

--pr-measure.meaning: The longest comfortable line for reading text.

--pr-gap-component.meaning: Inside a component: icon to label, label to field.

--pr-gap-group.meaning: Between the elements of one group: fields in a form, items in a list.

--pr-gap-section.meaning: Between sections. Clearly larger than a group gap, so grouping reads.

--pr-gutter.meaning: The space between the viewport edge and content.

--pr-control-height.meaning: The height of a single-line control.

--pr-target-min.meaning: The smallest pointer target (WCAG 2.2 AA asks 24px).

--pr-container-reading.meaning: The maximum width of reading pages and documentation.

--pr-container-full.meaning: Full width, for app surfaces that use the whole screen.

--pr-radius-control.meaning: This is something you operate (a button, a field).

--pr-radius-well.meaning: This holds content of another kind (code, a key).

--pr-radius-layer.meaning: This sits on top of the page (a popover, a dialog).

--pr-radius-round.meaning: This is a person or a single status (an avatar, a dot).

--pr-border-width.meaning: A line that separates or outlines.

--pr-focus-width.meaning: The width of the focus ring: here is where the keyboard is.

--pr-focus-offset.meaning: The gap between an element and its focus ring.

--pr-elevation-0.meaning: Part of the page. No shadow.

--pr-elevation-1.meaning: On top of the page but not interrupting it: a menu, a popover, a tooltip.

--pr-elevation-2.meaning: Interrupts the page: a dialog. Only one at a time.

--pr-layer-sticky.meaning: Something that stays while the page scrolls (a table header, a toolbar).

--pr-layer-overlay.meaning: A layer above the page that is not in the browser top layer.

--pr-layer-toast.meaning: A message that must stay visible over everything else on the page.

--pr-duration-fast.meaning: Acknowledgement: hover, press, a state change.

--pr-duration-base.meaning: Something entering or leaving: a popover, a disclosure.

--pr-duration-slow.meaning: A large layer entering: a dialog, a panel.
